scientific_integrity: Analytical argument based on arXiv:2609.39008v1 exact nodal theorem and DLMF asymptotics; finite computations are supplementary. No independence or universal external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform only when n/nu lies in a fixed compact subset of (0,infinity); no turning-point, far-tail or non-J cylinder-phase claim; requires standard differentiable Debye expansions; no independent audit.
title: Uniform double-scaling laws for the sharp nodal Bessel Turán constants
